sovereign_country.strategic_role: 极速离岸证券与外汇交易商持牌（VFSC）、轻资产免税出海

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Airport Bonded In-Flight Meal Production and Direct Ramp Delivery

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid – English common law, French civil law influences, and customary law (kastom)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Vanuatu–France Investment Protection Agreement (continuing successor treaty)
Vanuatu–New Zealand Tax Information Exchange Agreement (active)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act No. 13 of 2016 (as amended by Act No. 26 of 2018); International Companies Act [Cap 222] (as amended); Companies Act [Cap 191] (as applicable); VFSC Beneficial Ownership and Register Regulations (International Companies) 2019; Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit guidelines on CDD and PEPs.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized copy of passport of each beneficial owner and director
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public in the country of origin of each individual
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular legalization by a Vanuatu High Commission/Embassy or authorized consular officer (Vanuatu is not a Hague Apostille Contracting State; apostille alone is not sufficient)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Original bank reference letter (issued within the last 90 days)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular legalization or apostille chain acceptable only where Vanuatu has expressly recognized the apostille via bilateral arrangement; default is consular legalization

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Professional reference letter from a lawyer or certified accountant confirming source of funds/wealth
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Licensed external legal or accounting professional
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular legalization by Vanuatu consular officer in the jurisdiction of signing

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all directors, shareholders, beneficial owners, and required company officers against the OFAC SDN list, UN Security Council Consolidated List, EU/UK consolidated sanctions lists, and Vanuatu domestic sanctions notices issued by the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit. PEP identification is required under section 20 of the AML/CTF Act using a licensed third-party sanctions/PEP database, with enhanced due diligence for any PEP, family member, or close associate. Customer and transaction records must be retained for at least 10 years after termination of the business relationship.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission – Company Registry Name Clearance and Reservation Portal (accessed through a licensed registered agent)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Names must be expressed in English or French (official languages) using Latin script only. Foreign names must be transliterated into Latin characters with a certification from the registered agent as to the true meaning. The proposed name must end with an approved company type suffix for an International Company, such as 'Limited', 'Ltd', 'International Company', 'I.C.', 'Corporation', 'Corp', 'Inc.', or 'LLC'.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If a name is rejected, the applicant has 14 calendar days from the rejection notice to file a written request for reconsideration with the Registrar of Companies at VFSC through its registered agent. The request must include the original rejection notice, a revised name or a memorandum in favor of the original name, and the applicable administrative fee. VFSC will decide within 21 business days. If the reconsideration is refused, an aggrieved applicant may apply to the Supreme Court of Vanuatu for judicial review under the Companies Act and Civil Procedure Rules.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A registered office in Vanuatu at the registered agent's address is mandatory and may be virtual. The Vanuatu International Company (IC) must conduct all operational business outside Vanuatu; the airline inflight catering kitchen must be physically located and licensed in the operational jurisdiction, not in Vanuatu. A virtual office is acceptable for the company's seat/address, but not as a substitute for a physical catering facility where the airline contract requires local production.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low probability, estimated annual unannounced physical on-site inspection risk of less than 5% for a non-licensed offshore international company; VFSC inspection programs are primarily targeted at licensed financial institutions and trust service providers.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission – name reservation fee
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff under the VFSC Fees Regulation made pursuant to the International Companies Act Cap 222

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission – incorporation filing fee for an International Company
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff under the VFSC Fees Regulation and International Companies Act Cap 222

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registered agent service fee (first year, including UBO register filing and compliance interface)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Licensed Vanuatu registered agent / corporate service provider
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark prevailing for Vanuatu International Company maintenance

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registered office / virtual office address service fee
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Licensed Vanuatu registered agent / corporate service provider
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark for corporate registered office services

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: AML/CFT onboarding, sanctions screening, PEP database checks, and UBO risk assessment
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Licensed compliance service provider or external attorney
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark for AML compliance fees and database licensing

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarial, consular legalization, and translation fees for mandatory due diligence documents
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Notary public and Vanuatu consular/High Commission officials in jurisdiction of document origin
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Actual disbursement based on official notarial and consular fee schedules

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: External legal professional fee for pre-incorporation due diligence review, drafting UBO declarations, and issuing post-incorporation legal opinion
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Professional legal fee at prevailing market benchmark for Vanuatu international corporate work

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Courier, expedited handling, and transaction bank interface fees (pre-incorporation correspondence)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Various (registered agent, courier provider, correspondent bank)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market rate for express international courier and administrative coordination

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act No. 32 of 1992, as amended (International Companies Act, Cap. 222), Sections 5 (Registration), 14 (Memorandum and Articles), 28-34 (Shares and Capital), 35-38 (Registered Office and Agent), and 41-47 (Directors and Officers)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), Registry of International Companies
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Application for Registration of an International Company (Form A) and Statement of the Registered Agent under the International Companies Act
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital; incorporation permitted with zero paid-up capital. No escrow or bank deposit requirement for International Companies.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED that the subscriber approves and adopts the Memorandum and Articles of Association of the Company in the form registered with the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission. RESOLVED FURTHER that the subscription of ordinary shares as set forth in the Application be duly accepted, and that the registered office of the Company be established at the registered agent's premises in Port Vila, Vanuatu. RESOLVED that the following persons be and are hereby appointed as officers of the Company: Director(s) and Secretary as designated in the register. RESOLVED that the Chairman and any director are authorized to execute all filings, banking instruments, and licensing applications necessary for the Company's formation, corporate governance, and industrial operations.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Engage Registered Agent and Reserve Company Name
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC-licensed registered agent (private law firm or corporate services provider) acting through the VFSC online portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a name reservation request for a distinct international company name, provide the proposed corporate purpose (airport bonded inflight catering), and execute a registered agent engagement letter. The agent will verify name availability against the VFSC's electronic register and file the reservation, if applicable.
required_dossiers: Certified copy of passport of beneficial owner
Certificate of address of registered office (agent's confirmation)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected due to confusion or prohibited character, immediately file an alternative name via the same agent and re-submit the reservation with additional search results.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registered agent (drafting) with subsequent notarization by a Vanuatu notary public
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The registered agent drafts the Memorandum and Articles of Association, the Application for Registration (Form A), and the Statement of Registered Agent. The subscriber executes the incorporation documents and the first director consents to act. Notarized attestation is obtained where required.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If VFSC queries corporate purpose language or capital clauses, amend the Memorandum and Articles through a supplementary resolution and resubmit within 5 business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: File with VFSC and Obtain Certificate of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission – Registry of International Companies (online e-portal)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The registered agent submits the executed package to the VFSC Registry, pays the official filing fee (USD 350), and receives the Certificate of Incorporation and registered charter number. If the filing is made before 2:00 PM local time, issuance occurs the same day; otherwise, next business day.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Upon VFSC requisition, correct any deficiencies in the professional-language requirements or director details and re-file within 7 days. A formal administrative review may be requested if the requisition is based on an evident error.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Appoint First Board, Registered Office, and Corporate Records
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Board of Directors (through first board resolution) and the company secretary in conjunction with the registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Hold the first board meeting either virtually or in person; pass the written first board resolution covering share subscription, registered office adoption, and officer appointments. Maintain the statutory registers (members, directors, officers, charges) at the registered office. Issue share certificates to the subscriber.
required_dossiers: Written minutes of first board meeting
Statutory register of members and directors
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If any appointment is rejected by the agent or the Financial Intelligence Unit, revoke the appointment and hold a board resolution to substitute a qualified candidate immediately, without altering the Certificate of Incorporation.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Vanuatu Investment Promotion Authority (VIPA) – One-Stop Business Registration Office, under the Ministry of Trade, Tourism, Industry and Commerce
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Foreign Investment Registration Certificate (FIRC) and Commercial Business Licence (Trade Code: 5621 – Event Catering / Food Manufacturing) authorizing airport bonded inflight meal production and ramp delivery

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Vanuatu Department of Environmental Protection (DEP), Ministry of Climate Change Adaptation, Meteorology, Geo-Hazards, Environment and Energy
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category B – Environmental Impact Assessment (EIA) screening required; full Environmental Impact Statement (EIS) required for facilities with daily meal production exceeding 500 meals, wastewater discharge to water bodies, or cold storage using ozone-depleting refrigerants
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Industrial wastewater discharge must meet Vanuatu National Effluent Standards (turbidity ≤ 50 NTU, BOD ≤ 50 mg/L, COD ≤ 250 mg/L, oil & grease ≤ 15 mg/L) or connect to a municipal sewer with pre-treatment; solid food waste must be tracked and disposed by a licensed contractor; VOC emissions from cooking operations must be controlled via exhaust scrubbers to comply with ambient air quality thresholds; adherence to SPREP waste management guidelines for Pacific island states

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety clearance from Vanuatu Fire Service and Port Vila Municipal Council (annual fire certificate, sprinkler and extinguisher inspection); structural load inspection certificate from the Public Works Department for kitchen equipment and cold storage floor loading; occupational hygiene clearance from the Department of Labour (Occupational Safety and Health) covering kitchen ventilation, slip-resistant flooring, food handling staff health cards, and hazard communication signage

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Vanuatu Customs and Inland Revenue (VCIR), Ministry of Finance and Economic Management, Government of Vanuatu - official portal: https://customsinlandrevenue.gov.vu
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: (1) Appoint a licensed registered agent under the International Companies Act to incorporate the VU_IC and obtain the Certificate of Incorporation from the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC). (2) Submit the VAT/TIN registration application, together with the certificate of incorporation, registered office certificate, and foreign beneficial ownership declarations, to the VCIR using official Form VAT/TIN-1. (3) The VCIR will issue a Tax Identification Number (TIN) and, if the bonded catering kitchen is a taxpayer, a separate VAT registration number. (4) Where local establishment is required for the in-flight kitchen, register the physical bond/entreport address with VCIR and Vanuatu Customs. (5) Maintain a local tax representative for ongoing filing and audit liaison.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: None available. Vanuatu has no income-tax check-the-box or entity-classification election regime. An International Company automatically holds a perpetual tax exemption under the International Companies Act [Cap. 222]; the only statutory election of relevance is the election to convert to a local company under the Companies Act, which would extinguish the exemption. No hybrid mismatch elections exist as Vanuatu imposes no income or withholding tax on ICs.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: VUV 3,000,000 (three million Vanuatu Vatu) of aggregate taxable supplies in a 12-month period; voluntary VAT registration is permitted below this threshold, and zero-rated export supplies count toward the threshold for registration but are not subject to VAT.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No national real-time fiscal clearance, e-invoicing, or digital stamping mandate currently applies in Vanuatu. VAT-registered businesses must issue a compliant VAT invoice (prescribed minimum invoice content under the Value Added Tax Act [Cap. 251]) within 28 days of supply. For bonded/export supplies, invoices must be cross-referenced with customs export declarations and maintained for a minimum of 7 years for VCIR audit.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: A supply qualifies for zero rated VAT where (i) goods are physically exported to a destination outside Vanuatu, including the supply of aircraft stores/in-flight meals delivered to an international airline for consumption on an international flight; (ii) services are supplied to a non-resident airline or in connection with international carriage; and (iii) the supplier retains contemporaneous documentary proof of export and foreign payment. The bonded in-flight catering kitchen should treat direct ramp deliveries as exports only when the meals are loaded on to a departing international aircraft and covered by a customs export endorsement.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs export declaration (Vanuatu Customs export endorsement for bonded catering stores)
Air waybill / bill of lading evidencing the international carriage of the in-flight catering load
Inward remittance certificate / foreign currency bank credit advice evidencing payment received from the overseas airline
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The VCIR can reassess any claimed zero-rated supply at the standard 12.5% VAT if the exporter cannot substantiate the physical export or the receipt of proceeds within 180 days. Late payment or misdeclaration penalties run at up to 25% of the net tax due plus 1.5% monthly interest; fraudulent zero-rating claims are criminal offences under the VAT Act and Customs Act, punishable by fine and imprisonment (maximum on indictment up to VT 5,000,000 and/or 5 years). Retrospective clawback extends to all VAT, penalties, interest, and audit costs.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Reserve Bank of Vanuatu (RBV) – the statutory monetary and banking regulator under the Reserve Bank of Vanuatu Act [Cap. 283]; the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) supervises financial service providers and the International Company registry. For Vanuatu International Companies, no exchange-control approval is required for operational transfers, but banks must apply RBV prudential guidelines and Vanuatu AML/CFT obligations.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Vanuatu vatu (VUV) is fully convertible for current international payments under Vanuatu's IMF Article VIII status; capital transfers and profit repatriation by International Companies are unrestricted, except for bank-level source-of-funds verification. Foreign-currency account retention is permitted, and there is no compulsory conversion of export receipts into VUV. Remittance of dividends, royalties, and management fees to non-residents may proceed via normal commercial wire, accompanied by board resolutions and audited financial statements where required by the receiving bank.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No statutory surrender ratio or mandatory conversion timeline applies to export receipts for International Companies in Vanuatu. However, export/delivery proceeds from inflight-catering sales must be banked within the contractual settlement period, ordinarily not exceeding 120 days, with supporting sales invoices, airway bills, proof of delivery, and airline statements retained for VFSC inspection and bank transaction-monitoring review.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account and Capital Escrow Account
Local Currency Operational Account with trade-services desk

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility: Low. Offshore digital EMIs have no Vanuatu banking licence and cannot be used for primary clearing or settlement of VUV or foreign exchange in Vanuatu. They may only serve as supplementary invoicing/collection gateways if the EMI is already engaged by the airline payer and the Vanuatu IC maintains a dominant domestic banking relationship; no VFSC/RBV regulatory permission is granted for an unlicensed EMI to act as a depository. Any locally domiciled EMI must obtain a Category 3 Financial Services licence under the Vanuatu Financial Services Dealers Act and comply with RBV licensee obligations.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical appearance is required for first-time onboarding: at least one director or senior authorised signatory must attend a face-to-face interview at the chosen bank's Port Vila branch or at an RBV-recognised offshore banking counter. Remote opening is possible only for a low-risk International Company with a Vanuatu registered agent, notarized corporate documents, pre-existing bank relationship with a reputable introducing financial institution, and a remote video-KYC interview conducted by the bank's compliance officer.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Offshore International Company with opaque UBO/ownership structure or nominee directors
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified Certificate of Incorporation and Certificate of Incumbency, notarized extract from the VFSC corporate register, passport copies of each shareholder and director, independent UBO declaration, tax-residence certificates of all beneficial owners, and a corporate-structure flowchart signed by the company secretary.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-risk aviation corridor or third-party supplier payments that may touch sanctioned parties
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Executed airline inflight-catering master service agreement, purchase orders with tail-number reference, ramp delivery docket acknowledgements, airport-issued access licenses, food-safety/GHP/HACCP certifications, a detailed transaction rationale memo, and full sanctions-screening reports for every counterparty.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Lack of local economic substance or absence of an operational office in Vanuatu
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Registered-office agreement in Port Vila, management-services agreement with a licensed Vanuatu corporate service provider, local board meeting minutes, payroll records for Vanuatu resident directors or employees, and annual substance declaration for the International Company.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: PEP, adverse-media, or sanctions screening hits on counterparties or intermediate beneficiaries
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: UN/OFAC/EU/Vanuatu authorised-screening results, adverse-media and negative-news search reports, PEP status declaration, onboarding questionnaire, control-room waiver memorandum, and a documented compliance decision on whether to continue, restrict, or reject the relationship.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Parent or sponsor capital injections must be wired via SWIFT MT103 to the Vanuatu IC operational account. Instructions must carry the beneficiary IC legal name and VFSC registration number, bank BIC and account/IBAN code, and a purpose line expressly stating 'equity subscription / shareholder loan injection under the Vanuatu International Companies Act'. A bank-completed source-of-funds declaration (RBV/AML form) and a copy of the board-approved capital injection statement are required. USD inflows settle through New York correspondent clearing; VUV inflows settle through RBV local clearing infrastructure.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Routine supplier settlements use SWIFT MT103 corporate wires. High-value bonded-food, aviation catering equipment, or bulk-packaging purchases should be structured as documentary irrevocable letters of credit under UCP600 (SWIFT MT700) requiring the full set of documents: commercial invoice, packing list, airway bill or bill of lading, original certificate of origin, health/GMP/HACCP certificate, insurance document, and any required airline conformity certificate. Recurring monthly disbursements to airline kitchens can be executed through a virtual-account or payment-hub structure with positive-pay matching and automated reconciliation.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable Vanuatu vatu/USD forward contracts, up to 12 months tenor, supported by underlying trade contracts and approved by the onshore bank treasury
Offshore USD/VUV non-deliverable forwards (NDFs), settled in USD due to shallow onshore VUV liquidity, requiring trade substantiation and compliance with RBV monitoring thresholds

Cross-currency swaps and plain-vanilla interest-rate currency swaps for long-term capital or procurement financing, requiring treasury approval and RBV notification where gross notional exceeds USD 10,000,000
FX collar and zero-cost participating options on USD/JPY/EUR/VUV for airline invoicing and operational expenditure hedging, offered by international banks and settled through offshore branches

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual International Company (Exemption) Renewal and Government Maintenance Fee
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Due on or before each anniversary of incorporation; VFSC-registered agent must submit the annual renewal and payment by the anniversary date
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-payment surcharge of 10% per month or part month on arrears up to a maximum of 100%; administrative strike-off initiated by VFSC if unpaid for three consecutive months; restoration requires payment of all arrears, penalties, and a reinstatement fee

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual UBO and Compliance Declaration (Registered Agent AML/CFT Filing)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually on the anniversary of incorporation and immediately upon any shareholding transfer or change of 10% or more beneficial ownership
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to file or maintain accurate UBO records subjects the agent and the company to AML/CFT enforcement action, monetary penalties under Vanuatu AML/CFT regulations, potential disqualification of the registered agent, and ultimate administrative strike-off of the International Company

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Statutory Register Audit and Minute Book Review (Corporate Secretarial Internal Compliance)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Board of Directors and VFSC-licensed registered agent (no filing with VFSC)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annual review on the anniversary of incorporation and upon any change of directors, members, or registered details; registers must remain physically available at the registered office in Vanuatu
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: No direct government penalty for internal register deficiencies; however, failure to maintain statutory registers may result in evidentiary default in liquidation, loss of limited-liability protection, and inability to rely on corporate records before courts or counterparties

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Aviation Catering Business License and Airport Concession Permit Renewal (Operational License for Inflight Catering Operations)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Department of Civil Aviation (VDCA) and concession authority of the operating airport (where the catering kitchen physically operates in Vanuatu)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annual renewal aligned with the calendar-year concession or an anniversary date specified in the airport concession agreement; must be kept current throughout the term of airline supply contracts
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Suspension of in-flight meal production and direct ramp delivery privileges, fines under Vanuatu civil aviation regulations, potential termination of airport concession rights, and contractual default under airline catering agreements

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No mandatory statutory audit applies to an exempt Vanuatu International Company under the International Companies Act [Cap. 222]; audit becomes compulsory only if the company ceases to hold a valid exemption certificate and carries on business within Vanuatu, if VFSC orders an audit under the IC Act, or if the company is converted into a domestic local company subject to Vanuatu Companies Act audit thresholds
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Vanuatu applies IFRS for public interest entities and Vanuatu GAAP for domestic local companies; exempt International Companies may maintain simplified accounting records and are not required to file financial statements with VFSC

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The VFSC-licensed registered agent must maintain a current and complete UBO register and submit an annual confirmation to VFSC on each incorporation anniversary; any share transfer or change of beneficial ownership equal to or above 10% must be notified to the agent immediately and reflected in the updated confirmation before anniversary renewal

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 300 to USD 800 per annum for VFSC-licensed registered agent services, inclusive of registered office, nominee directorship administration, and annual compliance filings
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 2,000 to USD 5,000 per voluntary audit engagement where required for airline counterparty due diligence, financing, or insurer purposes (not statutorily required for an exempt International Company)

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0%: Vanuatu levies no domestic corporate income tax on International Companies; the IC is a tax-exempt offshore entity subject to fixed VFSC annual fees, VAT on local consumption where legally triggered, customs duties on imported catering inputs, and annual business licence fees.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Nil income tax on worldwide profits; no capital gains tax; no payroll or PAYE; no estate, gift or wealth taxes; zero-rated VAT treatment for bonded in-flight meal sales delivered to aircraft in international traffic; input VAT credit and refund mechanism for exported catering supplies; flat annual government fee regime in lieu of profit-based taxation.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: VFSC International Company Annual Return / Certificate of Compliance, filed by the licensed registered agent through the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) online company registry portal; no corporate income tax return exists in Vanuatu.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due on the anniversary date of incorporation; the annual government fee is payable within 30 days of the anniversary and the return must be certified by the registered agent on the same date.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered company number, exact legal name, date of incorporation and jurisdiction of incorporation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Insert the name exactly as it appears on the VFSC Certificate of Incorporation; a mismatch triggers rejection of the filing and a regulatory rectification fee.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Physical registered address in Vanuatu, which must be the office of the licensed registered agent.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Use the registered agent's address, not the airport kitchen address; the kitchen address appears only in the business licence and VAT registration files.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Name, licence number and contact details of the Vanuatu-licensed registered agent maintaining the books, records and beneficial ownership register.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The registered agent must be an entity licensed by the VFSC; a non-resident director or shareholder cannot act as registered agent.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Full names, residential addresses and identity document details of each director and the company secretary.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A sole natural-person non-resident director is permitted; corporate directors are prohibited for International Companies; nominee directors must be disclosed to the registered agent.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Authorised capital, issued shares, class of shares and currency denomination.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: No minimum paid-up capital requirement applies; shares may be denominated in any currency; bearer shares are prohibited under the amended International Companies Act 2022.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration that the IC has not carried on business with Vanuatu residents and has not engaged in domestic trade, except for offshore operations with non-resident counterparties.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For the bonded airline catering kitchen: the catering contract must be executed outside Vanuatu with the non-resident airline; title to the meals must pass outside Vanuatu or on board the aircraft; domestic sales to local airlines or airport staff must be strictly avoided to preserve IC exempt status.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Automatic late-renewal surcharge of 10% of the unpaid annual fee for each month of default, strike-off of the company after 90 days of continued non-payment, and restoration costs of up to VUV 250,000 before the company can re-engage in legal transactions.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: VAT Return (VAT-100 equivalence) submitted through the Vanuatu Revenue and Customs Department (VRC) e-services portal; applicable only where the IC holds a local VAT registration for the airport catering premises.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Monthly; quarterly filing may be granted at the Commissioner's discretion for low-turnover registrants, but a high-volume bonded catering operation is ordinarily required to file monthly.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Filing and payment are due on or before the 15th day of the month following the end of the VAT period.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross value, exclusive of VAT, of 12.5% standard-rated taxable supplies made in Vanuatu.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report only sales legally made to domestic-flight airlines or to customers inside Vanuatu; for international-flight contracts, reclassify the value to Box B and attach the bonded export evidence.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box B – Zero-rated and exported supplies
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Zero-rated exports and bonded supplies delivered to aircraft engaged in international traffic.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Retain the signed airline purchase order, aircraft rotation schedule, ramp access log, delivery docket and customs outward declaration; without complete evidence the VRC will reclassify the revenue as standard-rated and assess VAT at 12.5% with penalties.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: VAT paid on catering inputs such as raw food, packaging, cleaning materials, utilities and qualifying equipment, supported by valid tax invoices.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Input VAT is creditable against output VAT only; in a fully zero-rated export operation the excess credit becomes a refund claim subject to VRC audit; non-resident ICs must provide a local bank account or assign the refund to a local controlling entity.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box D – Net VAT payable or refund due
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Difference between output VAT and recoverable input VAT.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Any refund must be claimed in the same filing; the VRC may withhold payment pending inspection of the bonded warehouse and physical verification of the meal export records.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Immediate late-filing penalty of 5% of the VAT amount payable, monthly interest of 2% on unpaid VAT, a fixed default assessment of between VUV 100,000 and VUV 500,000, and suspension of the customs bonded licence upon repeated default.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Business Licence Renewal under the Business Licence Act, filed with the Provincial Administration or Municipal Council governing the airport bonded catering kitchen; the food-safety endorsement is issued by the Ministry of Health.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: The licence is issued for the calendar year and expires on 31 December; the renewal application must be lodged before expiry and the licence fee paid by the date stated in the renewal notice, normally 31 January of the following year.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Physical address of the catering facility, ISIC/NAICS activity code for food manufacturing and in-flight catering, and expected gross turnover for the licence year.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The physical kitchen disqualifies the IC from being a purely passive offshore vehicle; the licence must name the IC as the operator and the premises as a customs-bonded zone inside the airport perimeter.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Reference number of the Foreign Investment Registration Certificate or an express statutory waiver for bonded airport operators.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident ownership of the catering business requires a Foreign Investment Registration; the IC tax exemption certificate does not replace the investment permit.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Schedule C – Public health and HACCP endorsement
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Vanuatu food-safety licence and HACCP certification number issued by the Ministry of Health and the Airport Authority.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: HACCP certification is a statutory precondition for in-flight meal production; lapse of the health certificate automatically suspends the business licence and exposes directors to personal liability for continued operation.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Non-renewal triggers a daily non-compliance fee of 10% of the annual licence fee, court enforcement and closure of the kitchen; unauthorised food production attracts a health and safety fine of up to VUV 1,000,000 and immediate suspension of the bonded status.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0%: Vanuatu imposes no dividend withholding tax, no advance corporate tax, and no distribution tax on dividends paid by an International Company to non-resident shareholders.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Vanuatu has no comprehensive double tax agreement for income in force, so no DTA relief claim can be made. The governing protocol for a clean dividend distribution is: (1) obtain a current Vanuatu Tax Exemption Certificate from the VFSC confirming the IC has no Vanuatu tax liability; (2) obtain a Tax Residence Certificate (TRC) of the beneficial shareholder from the shareholder's home tax authority; (3) adopt a directors' resolution declaring the dividend and confirming that the profit originates from genuine arm's-length catering contracts; (4) remit through the corporate bank account with the resolution, the IC exemption certificate and the shareholder TRC attached; and (5) maintain a transfer-pricing and economic-substance file so that the shareholder's home jurisdiction does not reclassify the dividend as a constructive dividend or controlled-foreign-company income.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Vanuatu statutory rate: 0% for interest and royalties paid by an IC to non-residents; effective treaty rate is also 0% because no income tax treaties exist. However, global minimum top-up tax and CFC rules of the recipient's residence state may still tax the income, so a written international tax opinion is recommended before booking intercompany royalties, management fees or shareholder loans.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: No statutory transfer-pricing documentation threshold exists in Vanuatu law; best-practice threshold: prepare a full Local File and group Master File when related-party in-flight catering turnover exceeds VUV 200,000,000 (approximately USD 1,650,000) per annum, and maintain a simplified economic-substance file at all turnover levels.
approved_arm_length_methodologies: CUP (Comparable Uncontrolled Price) – preferred for airline meal pricing where independent caterers exist
Resale Price Method (RPM) – suitable for distribution or logistics middle entities
Cost Plus Method (CPM) – preferred for the kitchen's production and processing function
Transactional Net Margin Method (TNMM) – fallback for imputed profit margin on the flight-catering services
Profit Split Method (PSM) – used when both the IC and the airline group contribute unique intangibles such as recipes, branding or quality systems
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Applicable: the Vanuatu Economic Substance Regulations 2022 (as amended) require every International Company, including tax-exempt ones, to satisfy an economic substance test for 'relevant activities'. An airline in-flight catering kitchen selling under a captive airline group contract is captured under the 'distribution and service centre' head if the services are provided to a related party in another jurisdiction, and under general rules if the kitchen performs intra-group procurement, processing and logistics. The IC must demonstrate in its annual ESR return to the VFSC: (a) the catering business is directed and managed in Vanuatu through local board meetings and documented management decisions; (b) a qualified full-time workforce physically operates the kitchen, including chefs, HACCP officers, quality controllers and ramp logistics staff; (c) the kitchen owns or leases its premises, cooking equipment and delivery vehicles in Vanuatu; (d) monthly operating expenditure in Vanuatu is proportionate to the group service fee; and (e) core income-generating activities, namely menu design, procurement, food production, quality control and direct ramp delivery, occur in Vanuatu. Failure to file the ESR return or failure to satisfy the substance test results in removal of the tax-exempt certificate, a monetary penalty, and possible strike-off.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating the bonded catering kitchen without any directed-and-managed process in Vanuatu, using the IC purely as an invoicing conduit, or claiming tax-exempt offshore status while the kitchen functions as a domestic restaurant, local supplier, or domestic-flight caterer without a separate taxable entity.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Strike-off under the International Companies Act 2022, withdrawal of the tax exemption certificate, revocation of the catering and bonded-warehouse licences, and reassessment of all concealed VAT and customs duties with a penalty equal to 300% of the tax foregone.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors are jointly and severally liable for civil restitution to the VFSC and the VRC; the VFSC may impose travel bans and asset-freezing orders; continuing to trade after strike-off notice is a criminal offence punishable by imprisonment of up to 12 months.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Filing a 'nil activity' ESR return while the IC's bank account receives recurring catering service fees from the airline group, or declaring inadequate employees and premises while serving international carriers from a fully equipped airport kitchen.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Fixed administrative penalty of up to VUV 1,000,000 for ESR non-compliance plus a daily default penalty of VUV 50,000; the VFSC may strike off the IC and exchange information with the airline group's home tax authority, triggering a CFC review abroad.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Each director and the registered agent bear personal liability for the penalties; directors may be disqualified from holding office in any Vanuatu company for up to 5 years; intentional misdeclaration is an offence punishable by imprisonment of up to 5 years and a personal fine of VUV 2,000,000.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Mixing duty-free bonded imports with unbonded local food inputs, selling bonded meals to domestic-flight airlines without accounting for VAT and import duty, or diverting bonded stock outside the authorised customs-bonded premises.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Seizure and forfeiture of the catering inventory and cooking equipment, an import-duty penalty of three times the duty evaded, cancellation of the customs bond, and a 5-year blacklisting of the operator from bonded catering licences.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors are personally liable for the unpaid duty and forfeited assets; criminal conviction for smuggling carries a fine of up to VUV 5,000,000 and imprisonment of up to 10 years; travel bans and pre-trial asset-protection orders may be issued.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failing to maintain the beneficial ownership register with the registered agent, using bearer or nominee share structures, routing dividend payments through non-bank payment intermediaries, or invoicing airline meals through an unrelated shell to disguise the ultimate shareholder from the VFSC and the Financial Intelligence Unit.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The IC is a reporting institution under Vanuatu's AML/CFT framework and may be fined up to VUV 10,000,000 for a serious breach; the registered agent's licence is suspended; the Financial Intelligence Unit may obtain a provisional freezing order over all catering receivables and bank accounts.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and compliance officers face criminal liability: imprisonment of up to 10 years for money laundering, a personal fine of up to VUV 5,000,000, disqualification from directorships, and joint liability for the airline group's foreign tax penalties where the concealment causes a misdeclaration in the shareholder's home jurisdiction.
